BUKHAM PLAY · DEVELOPMENT NOTES

Shellbound: Skybound Run

A playable third-person 3D adventure with solo and two-player local co-op. Play the game →

Playable now

Floating islands, camera orbit, double jumps, air dashes, launch pads, moving platforms, sky gems, a timed lantern relay, feather collecting, a storm guardian, checkpoints and browser-local progress.

Multiplayer scope

Two players share one keyboard and camera. Online multiplayer, servers, matchmaking and player chat are not connected. A larger online version needs an authoritative game server, synchronised physics, account and session handling, moderation and load testing.

Creative direction

An original fantasy inspired by Nigerian storytelling, with market stalls, cloth patterns and a tortoise guide. It is not presented as an authenticated traditional tale. Cultural and language review is needed before expanding into named folklore adaptations.

Verification

Automated geometry, movement and mocked-renderer interaction checks pass. Desktop and mobile browser visual and performance testing remains outstanding.
